title: Trump shares 'very strange' accounts of round UFOs speeding past Air Force fighter jets
excerpt: President Donald Trump shared new details about aliens after previously committing to making UFO documents public
content:
Updated 13:54 9 Nov 2026 GMTPublished 12:43 9 Nov 2026 GMT

President Donald Trump previously committed to making UFO documents public

President Donald Trump has made a bizarre statement about stories he has heard from ‘handsome’ Air Force pilots about unidentified flying objects.

The US leader appeared in a recent episode of 60 Minutes where he unveiled some ‘very strange’ accounts he has heard of round UFOs speeding past fighter jets.

Trump spoke to Ross Douthat about the Republican losses in the midterm elections, the wars in Iran and Ukraine, as well as speculations about life beyond Earth.

The president explains: “I’m not too much of a believer, but I sat in the Oval Office first term and a little bit second term meeting with Air Force pilots that are really good, solid people.

President Trump has shared new information about UFOs (Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images)

“These are not people that you would say are conspiracy theorists. They don’t even know what it means, but they’re great, great pilots, young, handsome. They have beautiful, nice flat top, I'd like to have a haircut just like them, they look perfect like Tom Cruise.”

Trump went on to describe the pilots as the ‘real deal’, before going on to divulge stories they had shared with the president about UFOs.

He continued: “They’ve told me things that are very strange. They said that in certain cases they said, ‘Yes there’s something going on out there’, because they’re flying an F-22 which is the best there is, the fastest the best plane that anyone’s ever seen, and something goes by them at three times their speed and it’s round, it’s not aerodynamic, it’s round.”

The president admitted that there is a possibility that the unidentified object could be a ‘comet’ but that it remains a ‘mystery’.

UFO scientists pleads Trump to reveal files on aliens

This isn’t the first time Trump has released information on UFO activity, with the government previously committing to making documents on the subject public.

Taking to his own social media platform Truth Social earlier this year, Trump wrote: “Based on the tremendous interest shown, I will be directing the Secretary of War, and other relevant Departments and Agencies, to begin the process of identifying and releasing Government files related to alien and extraterrestrial life, unidentified aerial phenomena (UAP), and unidentified flying objects (UFOs), and any and all other information connected to these highly complex, but extremely interesting and important, matters. GOD BLESS AMERICA!”

Trump previously committed to making UFO documents public (VICTOR de SCHWANBERG/SCIENCE PHOTO LIBRARY/Getty Images)

In response to this, Dr Eric Davis, who has spent decades working with the Pentagon’s UFO program, shared that he believes the American people ‘have a right to see’ what is going on.

As a result, Davis made a public plea to Trump to waive his NDA in order to ‘protect UAP whistleblowers’ such as himself.

In a video, he said: “I respectfully request that you take swift and decisive action as the nature of UAP should not be kept deeply classified.” However, Trump has not yet shared whether or not this request will be fulfilled.
